apps.title: Simon Tatham's Puzzles
apps.blurb: Forty small logic puzzles. No timer, no streak, no reason to come back tomorrow.

apps.title: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
apps.blurb: A roguelike dungeon crawl. Runs end; there is nothing to buy.

apps.title: Vector Pinball
apps.blurb: Pinball tables drawn in lines. Ball drains, table resets, that is the loop.

apps.title: Frozen Bubble
apps.blurb: Match three bubbles by colour before the ceiling comes down.

apps.title: Toca Boca World
apps.blurb: A big creative sandbox — dress up, build rooms, make stories. Optional purchases; the publisher says it is ad-free, but nobody here has counted interruptions yet.

interruption.note: not on F-Droid; operator must supply the APK and record its digest with tools/record_apk.py

apps.title: BlockWorld
apps.blurb: A blocky creative world. Build, fly, keep animals, play together on your own wifi. No timer, no streak, nothing to buy.

interruption.note: about three hours of play across two children on 2026-08-29, over several sittings before and after dinner; no interruption of any kind occurred
